approval.note: false positive: adj+enough+to-infinitive notasyonu transkriptte literal degil

segments.text: Long before banks and credit cards, people already loved one shiny metal.
segments.englishExplanation: Long before modern banking existed, people already valued this shiny metal.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bankalardan ve kredi kartlarından çok önce, insanlar parıl parıl parlayan tek bir metali zaten çok seviyordu.

segments.text: It was easy to find in rivers, it didn't rust,
segments.englishExplanation: Gold was easily found in riverbeds and did not corrode.

segments.text: and it was soft enough to shape by hand.
segments.englishExplanation: It was soft enough to be easily crafted into different shapes by hand.

segments.text: Gold was one of the first metals to be discovered, and people had been using gold for
segments.englishExplanation: Gold was among the earliest metals discovered, and humans had been using it...
segments.turkishExplanation: Altın keşfedilen ilk metallerden biriydi ve insanlar altını...

segments.text: jewelry and coins for thousands of years before the first paper money appeared.
segments.englishExplanation: ...for ornaments and money for thousands of years before paper currency was invented.
segments.turkishExplanation: ...ilk kağıt para ortaya çıkmadan binlerce yıl önce takı ve madeni para için kullanıyordu.

segments.text: Kings wore it, traders carried it, and families kept it safe for the next generation.
segments.englishExplanation: Royalty wore gold, merchants used it for trade, and families saved it for future generations.
segments.turkishExplanation: Krallar giyer, tüccarlar taşır ve aileler gelecek nesil için onu güvende tutardı.

segments.text: Even today, gold still feels special, and it is easy to see why.
segments.englishExplanation: Gold maintains its unique status even today, and the reasons are obvious.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bugün bile altın hâlâ özel hissettiriyor ve nedenini anlamak çok kolay.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to indicate that something has the necessary degree of a quality to perform an action.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir şeyin belirli bir eylemi gerçekleştirmek için yeterli derecede özelliğe sahip olduğunu belirtmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: The metal was soft enough to bend easily.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: The past perfect continuous tense describes an action that started in the past and continued up until another point in the past.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Geçmişte başlayıp yine geçmişteki başka bir andan öncesine kadar devam etmiş eylemleri anlatmak için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: They had been searching for gold for months before they found any.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Hiç bulamadan önce aylarca altın arıyorlardı.

quiz.question: Gold was one of the first metals ______ and people ______ gold for jewellery and coins for thousands of years.

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("adj + enough + to-infinitive") segment 3'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
